1 teaspoon salt

1/4 cup vegetable oil

1 1/2 pound large ahi (previously steamed) or large shrimp, peeled, deveined

Juice of 1 lemon

Salt and freshly ground black pepper

1. Using a whisk, mix together flour and salt. Dip shrimp into flour, then in oil, turning to coat. Let remaining flour drip off, and drain on paper towels.  (Alternatively, shake off excess flour and coat in oil with your hands.)

3. Using your fingers, press shrimp gently, alternately pressing shrimp with your palms and thumb to make ridges. Sprinkle with lemon juice.  (Alternatively, you can squeeze lemon juice over shrimp before or after coating.)
